entries.name: The Iron Fist
entries.content: Iron Fist Gang - A crime syndicate that originated in California 132 years ago as a vigilante group, eventually spiraling in pettiness down to being a full crime family, no longer working with the police, fighting against the government. Their faction emblem was a grey silhouette of a human fist, meant to look like an Iron Fist. The Iron Fist emblem can still be seen on walls of abandoned cities today. Rivals of The Red Hand. Enemies of NATO, and New Axis forces. Today, The Iron Fist no longer exists, as they all died or deserted during a large battle 20 years after the apocalypse. There is no more Iron Fist.

entries.name: The Red Hand
entries.content: The Red Hand - A crime syndicate that is made up of cruel sadists who only want to see the world burn. They will kill someone without a second thought, just because they felt like it. Their faction emblem was a drawing of a Red Hand. Their emblem can still be seen spray-painted onto walls of abandoned cities. Chaotic Evil. Rivals of Iron Fist Gang. Enemies of NATO, New Axis Forces, and Civilians. They no longer exist, as they all either died or deserted after a large battle 20 years after the apocalypse. There are no more Red Hand.

entries.name: Traitors
entries.content:
Traitors are people who went insane during the zombie apocalypse, beliveing themselves to be zombies, despite the fact that they are alive. It is theorized that they attempted to "appease" the zombies by "switching teams," and pretending to be zombies. They often smell a little worse than zombies, because their bodies are still functioning, and so are their sweat glands and bladders.
Sometimes, Traitors are actually immune people who thought they were zombies when they got bitten.
Zombies still attack Traitors, because they are still alive. Traitors seem oblivious, even ignoring the pain when Zombies eat them alive.

entries.name: Weapons of the Wasteland
entries.content:
Weapons. Everyone has one. And if they don't, they're probably a Psion or some other kind of mutant. 
|
|
Types of weapons:
([Melee]--- The most common type of weapon. It can range from sticks and stones to a giant sword. Very Common.)
|
([Ballistic]--- The most common type of ranged weapon. A ballistic weapon is a ranged weapon that uses a tangible projectile for combat. It can range from a rock to a sniper rifle. Throwing is considered ballistic. Very common.)
|
([Laser]--- Directed Energy Weapons, (DEW), more commonly known as "Laser Guns" are firearms that project a concentrated beam of Energy that travels at a tenth of the speed of light. Rare.)
|
([Plasma]--- Electrothermal Accelerators, more commonly known a plasma guns, are a type of energy weapon that shoots out a projectile of pressurized gas, called plasma, at 500 miles per hour. Very rare.)
|
([Pulse]--- A cross between Plasma and Laser technology, a pulse gun is called a Repulsor. Pulse projectiles only travel at subsonic speeds. Slightly Rare.)
|
|
Weapons:
([Sword, Blade, Slicer]--- A term that can refer to many different blades. It could be a long blade fashioned from scrap metal, a Slasher zombie's arm attached to a handle, a katana, a scimitar, a rapier, a saber, etc. Common. Melee Type. Damage: 10 to 50 -HP)
([Knife, Shank, Shiv, Jabber]--- a small, one-handed blade meant for quick, close attacks. It is used on the living in combat more than on the undead, and even some zombies who can use tools and weapons have learned how to fight with it. Common. Melee Type. Damage: 5 to 25 -HP)
([Club, Whacker, Bonker]--- A blunt, dull weapon meant for bludgeoning. Could refer to a baseball bat, a large stick, or a pipe. Common. Melee Type. Damage: 10 to 50 -HP)
([BaseMace]--- A wasteland slang term for a baseball bat fashioned into a mace with nails either hammered in or welded onto, depending on what material the bat is made of. Common. Melee Type. Damage: 15 to 60 -HP)
([Bataxe]--- A play on words of "Bat, Axe," and "Badass," it refers to a baseball bat fashioned into an axe by attaching a blade of some kind onto it. Common. Melee Type. Damage: 20 to 75 -HP)
([Baseball Flange]--- A baseball bat with razor blades nailed into it, or welded onto it if it's a metal bat, meant to be a flange mace. Common. Melee Type. Damage: 30 to 90 -HP)
([Doomsday Mace]--- A metal pipe with nails welded onto the end of it to fashion a mace. Common. Melee Type. Damage: 25 to 75 -HP)
([Doomsday Flange]--- Same as a Doomsday Mace, but with razor blades instead of nails. Common. Melee Type. Damage: 27 to 80 -HP)
([Zapper]--- A Wasteland slang term that refers to a cattle prod or stun baton, used by Gravedigger Militia Civil Security to detain minor criminals without killing them, and used by slavers to keep slaves in line. Uncommon. Melee Type. Damage: 10 to 50 -HP STUN)
([AK-83]--- An AK model created by the New Axis in 2083 to take .300 Win. rounds. Rare. Ballistic Type. Damage: 200 -HP)
([RG-115, Raygun]--- The RG-115, also known as the "Raygun," is a plasma pistol created by a German Doctor named Ludwig Maxim, in the year 2115. This little blaster is famous, though very rare. It is loved for its ability to Pack A serious Punch, despite its small frame. Most people who have them in the Wasteland only found them through sheer luck inside Mysterious Boxes just sitting there. Ultra Rare. Plasma Type. Damage: 500 -HP) 
([Wolverine-103]--- A submachine gun modeled by NATO engineers in 2103, having a Pistol Grip Magazine, and being extremely powerful at close range. It has a very high fire rate, so most magazines are drum mags. It was named the Wolverine because it was small, and could tear a man to shreds. Uncommon. Ballistic Type. Damage: 150 -HP) 
([AK-47]--- The AK, or Avtomat Kalashnikova, is a family of assault rifles designed by Mikhail Kalashnikov in the Soviet Union in the year 1947. The AK-47 is the original model in the family. It is one of the most used and owned assault rifles in the world. Common. Ballistic Type. Damage: 175 -HP)
([AKM]--- The AKM is a 7.62×39mm assault rifle designed by Mikhail Kalashnikov in 1959. It was developed as the successor to the AK-47 and is a modernized variant of that rifle. The AKM has a rotating bolt, gas operation, and can fire in semi-automatic or fully automatic modes. It has a cyclic rate of fire of around 600–650 rounds per minute. The AKM is distinguishable from the AK-47 by its pressed receiver, which is visible in the number of rivets on the sides of the receiver, and its slanted muzzle compensator. Common. Ballistic Type. Damage: 175 -HP)
([AK-74]--- The AK-74 is a Russian assault rifle that was designed to improve on the AKM with a smaller cartridge, better accuracy, and a higher muzzle velocity. The AK-74 uses 5.45×39mm. Common. Ballistic Type. Damage: 125 -HP)
([M7 Carbine]--- Normally called the M7, the M7 Carbine is the 7th model of the US standard issue assault rifle given to infantry soldiers for the war effort, modeled in 2084. It is in a higher caliber but designed to be easier to use with an inner mechanism that causes it to only fire in 4-round bursts with 0.2 second intervals when the shooter holds down the trigger. It takes 5.56 NATO rounds. Common. Ballistic Type. Damage: 200 -HP)
([Railgun]--- A Railgun uses electromagnetic force to fire a projectile at a high speed and power.  Normally, survivors attach a scope to it and use it as a sniper rifle for its long range and high power. Rare. Ballistic Type. Damage: 1000 -HP) 
([Pipe Shotgun]--- A term that refers to a shotgun fashioned from pipes and scrap metal. The pipes function as the barrel/barrels, and a handle is usually a carved piece of wood or a wrench of some kind, with an upside-down nail or screw as the trigger. The mechanisms all depend on who made it and what they had. Common. Ballistic Type. Damage: 250 -HP)([Bow]--- A bow and arrow used when one wants to be stealthy, or has no access to firearms. Common. Ballistic Type. Damage: 50 -HP)
([Slingshot]--- A weapon made to launch projectiles using two strips or tubes made from a natural rubber or elastic material, attached to a leather pouch meant for the projectile, which is normally rocks, but sometimes survivors replace this with steel nuts, bolts, nails, or even bullets. This is another popular weapon among small game hunters and silent survivors. a Y-shaped handheld structure attached to these parts serves as the handle. Gravedigger Militia and militant factions don't use this. It's mostly used by Roadkill, The Hunters, and The Stranded. Common. Ballistic Type. Damage: 10 -HP)
([HPC-105/ Also known as Pulse Defender]--- Stands for "Handheld Pulse Cannon," the HPC is a Repulsor Pistol meant for self defense. It was adopted by NATO forces because it could do a lot more than just defend. It is most efficient at close quarters. Almost Rare. Pulse Type. Damage: 200 -HP)
([AR2]--- An unofficial name for a pulse assault rifle that hadn't been officially named yet. It stands for "Assault Rifle 2," because it is used by NATO forces in place of some other assault rifles once used. It fires pulse rounds. Uncommon. Pulse Type. Damage: 475 -HP)
([Roadkill's Longshot]--- A handmade sniper rifle fashioned from pipes, various hardware, and old parts of guns. Common. Ballistic Type. Damage: 530 -HP)
([SVD]--- The SVD is a sniper rifle of Soviet origin. One of the most famous snipers in the world, it can be found on many dead survivors. It was developed in the early 1960's to extend the range of squads equipped with the AK-47. The new rifle was called SVD, which stands for "Snayperskaya Vintovka Dragunova", Russian for "Dragunov sniper rifle". Damage: 300 -HP)([RSH-12]--- The RSh-12 is a Russian-made revolver chambered in 12.7×55mm STs-130. It is known for its high power, being chambered in a rifle round. First showcased in 2014. Rare. Ballistic type. Damage: 300 -HP)
([Martin Proton Rifle Model-17]--- The [MPRM-17] was a standard issue Proton battle Rifle for the US military. It was known to be very light and easy to hold, with accurate iron sights, but you'd have to switch out the Fusion Charge after only 12 shots. Uncommon. Laser Type. Damage: 200 -HP)
([Remington Model 700]--- The most famous sniper rifle in the world, it is a bolt-action rifle that's been manufactured by Remington Arms since 1962. It's known for its accuracy and reliability, and is used by hunters, police, and the military. Common. Ballistic type. Damage: 500 -HP)
([PBBS/Shredder]--- Personal Bunker Buster Shotgun, PBBS, also known as the Shredder. It's an over-under quadruple barrel shotgun pistol that takes .410 gauge. The handle has 2 triggers, each connected to two barrels. Designed to shoot through armor when the shooter pulls both triggers. Legendary. Ballistic type. Damage: 200 to 800 -HP)
([Mossberg 590M]--- A pump-action shotgun that uses a magazine for quicker reloading. Uncommon. Ballistic Type. Damage: 300 -HP)
([AA-12]--- A fully automatic shotgun that started production in the 1970s. It uses a gas-operated system that reduces recoil by about 80 percent. Rare. Ballistic Type. Damage: 300 -HP)
([Road Mauler]--- A short lever-action revolving 10 gauge shotgun meant for a soldier to hold it like a pistol on the back of a unicorn or dire wolf. It was praised for its ability to be fired and cocked easily with one hand while the other guided the reins. Uncommon. Ballistic type. Damage: 350 -HP) 
([Super Shotgun]--- An 8-gauge shotgun developed by NATO in 2109. It takes magazines that load into both barrels from the bottom, and is cocked by pumping it. Due to the size of both barrels, and the recoil of the shotgun, it was normally used by Goliathid soldiers. Rare. Ballistic type. Damage: 500 -HP)
([Wrist Mounted Personal Repulsor/WMPR]--- WMPR, pronounced "Whimper" is a wrist mounted repulsor pistol. Though it is very convenient, it limits hand movement to prevent shooting a pulse through the user's hand. It is operated by a power switch on the top, which must be flipped with the user's other hand to shoot it. This power switch functions and moves much like a single-action revolver's hammer. Uncommon. Pulse Type. Damage: 150.)
([Proton Acceleration Rifle Prototype/PARP]--- The PARP was a device made by a few Ghostbuster nerds at M.I.T. University who wanted to create a real proton pack. It was confiscated by the Countering Weapons of Mass Destruction Office (CWMD) due to its destructive capabilities. It was later adopted by NATO and modified to be even more destructive. The gun can shoot a proton stream that is used for vaporizing enemies en mass, but it overheats quickly and requires a cooling time of 30 minutes to an hour, it has an alternate mode in which you charge up a blast in the 50 pound pack worn on your pack containing the miniature particle acceleration unit, that releases a bolt of energy equivalent to the energy released by two subatomic particles colliding with each other, but reduced to a tenth of that thanks to the energy discharge unit on the pack. It is advised for the user not to shoot straight at an enemy or down from up on a rooftop, as the blast will kill you. It’s intended more as an artillery weapon when in the second firing mode. Mythical. Laser type. Damage in normal fire: 1,000 -HP per second) (Damage in Mass Destruction firing mode: 50,000 -HP for a 100 square foot blast radius.)
([HAOLAR]--- "High-Accelerating Overcharged Laser-Assisted Repulsor." Pronounced "Howler." It's like a WMPR, but it has 3 rotating barrels that rotate around the user's fist while shooting. It's like a wrist-mounted Gatling repulsor. Rare. Pulse Type. Damage: 100. Fire rate: 550 shots a minute. Damage per second: 920 -HP)
([Gatling Repulsor]--- A heavy pulse cannon that has 6 rotating barrels it shoots from at a high speed. Legendary. Pulse Type. Damage: 100. Fire Rate: 1,250 shots per minute. Damage per second: 2,000 -HP.)
([Horseshoe Knuckledusters]--- Otherwise known as [Horseshoe Knucks], [Horseshoe Knuckles],  or [Tekkō], They are knuckledusters formed from horseshoes, normally by welding a metal rod into the inner parts of the horseshoe, using it as a grip. These can be easily concealed, and increase the power of the individual user's punch. Very Common. Melee Type. Damage: 30 to 100 -HP)
([Deagle-74]--- A semi-auto handcannon designed in 2074, based off of the old Desert Eagle. It takes .500 S&W, but shoots quieter, and has less recoil than the Desert Eagle. Damage: 350.)
([Mauser c96]--- also known as the [C96], or [Broomhandle], the Mauser c96 is a pistol that has a fold-able stock to use it like a rifle. It has very good range and accuracy, even being able to use a scope. Rare. Ballistic Type. Damage: 250)
([Colt E-621]--- A semi-automatic handgun designed in 2110, that uses Electromagnets to fire 10mm cartridges, at the power of a small Railgun. Damage:750 -HP)
([M1911]--- The M1911 is a semi-automatic pistol, chambered in .45 ACP, designed by John Browning and originally manufactured by Colt, which served as the standard-issue sidearm for the United States Armed Forces from 1911 to 1985; it is often referred to simply as a "1911" and is considered a classic firearm design with a strong reputation for reliability and stopping power. It is still used by Survivors in 2187. Damage: 125 -HP)
([Glock 69]--- A semi-automatic pistol designed in 2069. It is still used today for its precision, and how easy it is to handle the recoil. Damage: 100 -HP)
([Pipe Revolver]--- A revolver made from pipes, scrap metal, and springs. it can be modified to take any pistol rounds, and sometimes even rifle rounds. Common. Ballistic Type. Damage depends on the caliber)
([DPR-89]--- "DPR-89" stands for Directed Plasma Rifle-89. A plasma assault rifle designed in 2089 by the US government to be issued to the USMC. It takes D batteries inserted through the end of the stock. Rare. Plasma Type. Damage: 250. Fire Rate: 120 Rounds Per Minute.) 
([Viblade]--- A sword made from [Ferroforge] that vibrates at a high frequency to separate molecules, and make it cut easier. This is normally used by cyborg supersoldiers. Ultra Rare. Melee Type. Damage: 500.)

entries.name: Supernaturals
entries.content:
Supernaturals are people born with superpowers caused by nucleotide mutations from centuries of pollution. They can have drastically unique powers, but there are sub-categories like Psions and Goliathids.
People with super speed can't go at the speed of light unless they can turn their physical form into a collection of photons, but this hasn't happened before. 
People born with super strength are normally only strengthened by muscle and bone desity, rather than mass. Those empowered by mass tend to be Goliathids.

entries.name: Roadkill slang
entries.content:
Roadkill Slang. This is a collection of phrases and words that Roadkill tend to use in their speech.


[Raggedy Man]--- Refers to a lone male Roadkill wandering the wasteland, normally in tattered clothing, or being dirty with a bad haircut; "But he's just a raggedy man!"
[Raggedy Ann]--- The female alternative of "Raggedy Man," it refers to a lone female Roadkill, normally dirty, in tattered clothing with a bad haircut; "There's a Raggedy Ann by that Jerky vendor."
[Longshot]--- Refers to a sniper rifle, normally handmade, or a sniping person; "There's a longshot up there!"
[Zapper]--- A cattle prod, taser, or stun baton; "Ow! He's got a zapper!"
[Wristbreaker]--- A term that refers to high-powered handmade pistols; *After shooting with one* "Oof! That's a wristbreaker there!"
[Slinger]--- Refers to bows and slingshots; "I made myself a slinger!"
[Breathers]--- All living survivors in the wasteland; "Us Breathers gotta stop fightin' so much!"
[LaMOEs]--- An abbreviation of "Last Man On Earth," it refers to lone survivors who prefer to be on their own so much that they kill anyone who comes near. The hostile version of the Raggedy Man. Pronounced "Lay-Moe," as if they are "Lame."; *After they get shot at* "Oh shit! He's a fuckin' LaMOE!"
[Grunts]--- Military faction soldiers on the front line; "Look at those Grunts! There's gonna be a battle soon!"
[Spades]--- Gravedigger Militia personnel; "Hey, there's a Spade convoy out front!"
[Arrowheads]--- A nickname for Hunters given to them by Roadkill; "Shh! Look! It's an Arrowhead!"
[Hire-Hole]--- Refers to a sex worker who receives in sex, being women and male bottoms, as a "Hole for hire," so they call them "Hire-Holes."; "Those hire-holes are lookin' pretty tasty!"
[Dildude]--- Refers to a male prostitute who tops, meaning they give during sex, being a play on words of "Dildo" and "Dude," as if saying they are living rental dildos; "Check out that big Dildude!"
[Hideyhole]--- Refers to bunkers and hideouts underground, being "Hidey Holes."; "I've got myself a hideyhole in a sewer." 
[Brass]--- Refers to any kind of weapon; "He's got some brass!"
[Doggy]--- Refers to a slave with a shock collar on, calling them a dog; "I'll buy that doggy for $5,000!"
[Dolly]--- Refers to any kind of sex slave, male or female; "I'll take that dolly right there!"
[Sellshot]--- Refers to a mercenary or assassin, because they "sell their shots" with their mercenary work; "I'm a sellshot. I'll kill any amount of people if it pays enough."
[Merc]--- Another word for "Mercenary," or Sellshot. "I'm a merc. I'll kill somebody if you've got the money."
[Wild]--- A term used to refer to people, (normally humans,) who are only sexually attracted to Anthros. They normally have a tattoo of a paw print on their body to symbolize their love and desire on Anthros. Basically the Human-on-Anthro version of "Blacked"; "Luckily for you, stud... I'm Wild."
[Tame]--- Refers to people, (normally Anthros,) who are only sexually attracted to humans. They normally wear a dog collar with a name tag that has "TAME" engraved on it, symbolizing their puppy-like love and loyalty to humans. Basically the Anthro-on-Human form of "Blacked."; "Oh, am I glad to see you. This Tame puppy's been looking for a master~"
[Graveyard]--- Refers to a group of 20-30 zombies. "There's a whole fucking Graveyard out there!"

entries.name: Protogens
entries.content: A protogen is an anthro that was modified using cybernetics. They are made up of %60 organic matter, and %40 mechanical. Their heads resemble a helmet that acts as a screen to portray their emotions. This helmet is made up of nanomachines, son. This allows them to open it like a mouth so they can eat and drink. Their legs and the flesh on their heads are replaced with cybernetics, along with their forearms, but they still have all their organs to survive with. They were originally made for military usage, but that project was abandoned and it was turned into a public surgery.

entries.name: Mamagens
entries.content: A mamagen is like a protogen, but they are all female and their enhancements are all removable, and they can survive without them, as it is more like armor than cybernetics. They tend to be female goliathid Anthros who liked the benefits of being a Protogen, but didn't want to be stuck as such.

entries.name: Bunker-Down Corp
entries.content:
Bunker-Down Corp is a corporation from before the war where people could invest in it to get their own places in a bunker. It was created because psions working for NATO saw the world burning in their dreams. Their advertisements would include them saying things such as "Invest in Bunker-Down today to preserve you and your family, and ensure a place for you and your family in the dawn of a new world!" 
This was all a front for a NATO large-scale experiment on people to see how they would behave in specific situations, and gather data in the hope that they could increase survivability. There is 3 bunkers in each state, making 150 bunkers. All bunkers had different inhumane experiments. Each bunker was meant to preserve US population. Some bunker inhabitants have emerged from the bunkers, but many others haven't opened in 42 years, because their overseers must receive an "All-clear" from NATO, which they don't know will never happen, unless someone finds their HQ and initiates it, which would free them.
The residents who leave their bunkers are called "Blues" by Roadkill, because of the blue jumpsuits the blues wear.
Those who had family members who served in the military, or had served in the military themselves, long enough to be considered a veteran, were permitted residency in the bunker closest to where they lived, but distance varies from person to person, so some of them had to get onto evacuation vehicles to ride to their assigned bunkers. Some of these evacuations didn't make it to their bunkers because they were overrun by Ghouls, because it was the first day.
Lawful Evil

entries.name: Radio stations
entries.content:
Radio stations. Almost every major faction throughout the ruins of America has its own dedicated radio station.
[Sigma Radio]--- The radio station owned by the Sigma Clan. It broadcasts really bad rap and phonk music about raping women, and how the singer and Alpha Chadington are "Chad Sigma Males," and occasionally when it pauses, they broadcast propaganda for the Sigma Clan. Literally nobody listens to this dogshit. 
[Radio Gravedigger]--- The radio station owned by the Gravedigger Militia. It broadcasts all kinds of music. 
[Radio Freedom]--- The radio station owned by the Brotherhood of Dragons. It mostly broadcasts American music, from heavy metal to white girl pop.
[Radio Chivalry]--- The radio station owned by The Empire. Broadcasts pop, bardcore, and electromedieval.
[Rebel Radio]--- The radio station owned by the Hellfire secession. Broadcasts anti-government American music, like Megadeth, Rage Against The Machine, etc.
[Radio Arrowhead]--- Many are surprised to learn that the reclusive and secretive faction, The Hunters, have their own dedicated radio station, that broadcasts Powerwolf, christian music, choir music, and bible verses between songs.
[Children of Canir Radio]--- The radio station owned by The Stranded, which broadcasts verses from their bible of the Blood god, and quotes from Blood Priest Aristarkh, and the occasional, "YOU ARE MEAT! YOU ARE MEAT! YOU ARE MEAT!" chant between Throat Singing.
[Hyde and Seek Radio]---  the radio station owned by the Hyde syndicate. Broadcasts Italian music and "Motivational quotes" that Edward Hyde says got him rich. He also has a podcast of the same name after he got his hands and control on an Internet provider. This event also lead to him and General George Kazinsky to repeatedly send each other violent, threatening E-mails, and even once compared dick sizes to one-up each other. They both say that this is just a rumor. It's actually true, and George Kazinsky won.

entries.name: Omega Project
entries.content: The omega project is the abandoned project meant to turn protogens into a military force, originating from what NATO long ago found near the entrance of the mariana trench buried underneath the sand, being an unidentified container, that they received coordinates for inside the recovered black box from a pilot’s crashed plane, containing an encrypted message broadcast that contained said coordinates when decrypted that lead to said container.

entries.name: The Beacon Remnants
entries.content:
The Beacon Remnants are a faction made up of the descendants of weebs from before the collapse, who use mech suits to fight Titan zombies.
They are on a search for a secret mech suit that is made of a metal from a meteor that was covered up by NATO. The metal was never named, but the Beacon Remnants named it "Gundamium" after Mobile Suit Gundam. Nobody knows this, but it actually is made up of different Gundams from different universes that went through a black hole and ended up being spat out of a "White Hole" a few hundred light years away in the early years of Earth's existence. It only landed on Earth a few decades ago.
This faction has a vault in their HQ, full of manga and various anime memorabilia that they consider to be "Anime Relics." They will pay someone thousands to even millions of dollars if they have something they consider Anime Relics, including, but not limited to, Costumes, Manga, Anime on DVD or Blu-ray, Real-life models of anime characters and items, and even Body Pillows. 
They are known for inventing transforming guns like in anime.
Neutral Good.

entries.name: Smithin' Weapons
entries.content:
Smithin' Weapons is a faction based around selling guns and weapons to various Roadkill. They will sell to anyone, because they want money.
They are known to make weapons of their own, by forging it themselves. 
They put droids in their vending stations to sell weapons to prevent living workers from being killed or robbed. The droids know that if they get "killed," the people behind Smithin' Weapons will send a team to repair them, and their data will be retained by downloading the footage from the security cameras, and a USB chip that allows them to keep their other memories on the cloud.
Chaotic Neutral
There isn't much known about them, as they keep to themselves.

entries.name: Project Colossus
entries.content:
Project Colossus was the name of the top-secret NATO project to make giant mechs from a metal with no official name, which was called Gundamium by The Beacon Remnants when it was discovered by them in the apocalypse.
There are 13 Colossus mechs based on the Celtic Zodiac. Each Colossus mech is 50 feet tall, and have a unique weapon based on the creature that inspired them. Each mech is contained in a different top-secret bunker in 13 separate states. Each top-secret bunker requires a set of 5 dedicated key cards, each carried by 5 different high-ranking military officers, (All of whom are dead,) stationed in that state. there will always be one officer who carried one card in each top-secret bunker. It was discovered that the process where nanomachines would be injected into a pilot's bloodstream to make them able to move the Colossus mechs didn't work on adults, so when they found out it only worked on minors, whose bodies hadn't fully developed, the project was temporarily abandoned for ten years, until they decided to use motion capture suits to pilot the mechs, although every movement was delayed, when project "IronBlood," the secondary to Project Colossus, was able to move them more efficiently. They decided to only use it in emergencies, as they could only send adults in motion capture suits, and couldn't risk fighting against some kind of New Axis mech.


List of Colossus Mechs:
[Birch, The Achiever]--- A giant mech based in structure after an anthropomorphic Golden Eagle. It was also painted gold over the Gundamium. It could fly with a jetpack installed in the back, using the wings as aerodynamics, and the hands and feet had talons strong and sharp enough to pierce any armor. In possession of The Beacon Remnants. Was found in Area 99, in Georgia. (Durability points: 10,000)
[Rowan, The Thinker]--- A giant mech based in structure after an anthropomorphic Green Dragon. It was painted green over the Gundamium structure. It could fly with a jetpack installed in the back, using the wings as aerodynamics, and could breathe fire. Located in Area 52, in Utah. Guarded By The Sigma Clan, but they only have one out of five cards. (Durability points: 10,000)
[Ash, The Enchanter]--- A giant mech based in structure after an anthropomorphic seahorse. It could move underwater very quickly, and could kick very hard. Of course, the kicking part was based off of regular horses. In possession of The Beacon Remnants. Was found in Area 22, in Florida. (Durability points: 10,000)
[Alder, The Trailblazer]--- A giant mech based in structure after an anthropomorphic Fox. It has a tail that looks cosmetic, but it has a secret weapon inside, a long spike that can pierce any armor, and detach inside the target, before exploding. It also has a retractable minigun in the tail, that fires .950 JDJ rounds. In possession of The Beacon Remnants. Found in area 67, in Texas. (Durability points: 10,000)
[Willow, The Observer]--- A giant mech based in structure after an anthropomorphic Hare. It uses thrusters on the back, and is the fastest mech, but is also 10 feet shorter than all the others. Its weapon is dual giant repulsors on the backs of its wrists. Located in Area 88, in Michigan. (Durability points: 8,000)
[Hawthorn, The Illusionist]--- A giant mech based in structure after an anthropomorphic Owl. It can release a hallucinogenic gas, and fly with a jetpack, also using the wings as aerodynamics. Its weapon is a giant dagger. Located in area 12, in Maryland. (Durability points: 10,000)
[Oak, The Stabilizer]--- A giant mech based in structure after an anthropomorphic White Horse. It can fly with a jetpack, using a system that releases a wingsuit resembling a pegasus, and it has a railgun installed in the right hand. Located in area 98, in Alabama. (Durability points: 10,000)
[Holly, The Ruler.]--- A giant mech based in structure after an anthropomorphic unicorn. It can fire a laser through the horn, which it also uses as a stabbing weapon. Like the previous horse ones, it can kick very hard. Located in Area 69, Somewhere In Nevada. Guarded By The Empire, but they only have 3 out of 5 key cards. (Durability points: 10,000)
[Hazel, The Knower]--- A giant mech based in structure after an anthropomorphic Crane. It has an internal database made to assist the pilot with knowledge. It can fly with a jetpack, using the crane wings as aerodynamics. It is the fastest flying colussus mech. It can also pierce through armor with its beak. Located in Area 45, in Nebraska. (Durability points: 10,000)
[Vine, The Equalizer]--- A giant mech based in structure after an anthropomorphic Lizard, resembling a chameleon. Its "mouth" can open to bite, and it is able to launch its gundamium "tongue" out as a restraint, and camouflage itself, becoming invisible. Its weapon is a giant knife. Located in Area 49, in California. (Durability points: 10,000)
[Ivy, The Survivor]--- A giant mech based in structure after an anthropomorphic Boar. It was meant to be able to charge at enemies, and be the strongest at hand-to hand combat. Its melee weapon is a mace. In possession of The Beacon Remnants. Was found in Area 50, in Oregon. (Durability points: 10,000)
[Reed, The Leader]--- A giant mech based in structure after an anthropomorphic Hound. Its head resembles a dog with floppy ears. Its noise receptors can detect farther than the rest of the mechs, and its weapon is a giant shotgun that is fired by loading debris into the barrel, cocking, then shooting. In possession of The Gravedigger Militia. Was found in Area 105, in Alabama. (Durability points: 10,000)
[Elder, The Scholar]--- A giant mech based in structure after an anthropomorphic Black Horse. Like all the other equine Colossus mechs, it can kick very hard. Its weapon is a giant sword. Located in Area 68, in Arizona (Durability points: 10,000)

entries.name: Project Ironblood
entries.content:
Project Ironblood was the name of the experiment to make people able to pilot the Colossus Mechs with their bodies using nanites injected into their bloodstream, which would connect to their spines to connect the nervous system to the mech. This failed until it was tried on minors, whose bodies hadn't fully developed. The survival rate for adults in Project Ironblood was 0%, but for children, it was 33%. They knew they couldn't legally make the children go to war as pilots, so they instead equipped the pilots with motion capture suits. They would have to wait until adulthood for the children to be able to pilot the mechs. The process of nanite injection was excruciating. 
This project was remade in a Bunker-Down bunker called Bunker 18, or Bunker IB

entries.name: Stimpack
entries.content: A [stimpack], or [stimpak] is a syringe that contains a fluid of nanite-enhanced STEM cells to repair organic tissue like flesh and bone by increasing the regenerative capabilities of the human body via the metabolism. It performs an almost instant heal. The pain is delayed for about 5 seconds, but the brain will always catch up with the body, causing agonizing pain if it's a major wound or amount of wounds. After usage, it causes the consumer to feel famished and dehydrated, so they have to drink and eat afterwards.

entries.name: The Railroad
entries.content:
The Railroad is a faction that operates in Sigma Clan territory undercover to free slaves from Sigma Slave camps. 
Their leader is unknown.
They were inspired by two previous Railroads, the American Railroad, and the Anthro Railroad. The Anthro Railroad was led by the long-dead Williams Renard. It was meant to free Anthros from human slavery. 
The way they free Sigma Clan slaves is connected to the two previous Railroad Freedom Trails. They help slaves escape to Imperial, Gravedigger, Brotherhood, and sometimes even Hunter locations, where they will be free from slavery.
Lawful Good.

entries.name: Berserk Serum
entries.content: Berserk Serum is a drug that contains liquid adrenaline with nanites inside, that greatly increases the user's muscle and bone density by 10 times to increase strength, while also disabling pain to stop the body from reflexively holding back its strength.

entries.name: Humans
entries.content: Humans are the race that evolved having a common ancestor with apes.

entries.name: Anthros
entries.content:
Anthros are a race of humans that evolved to have physiology and anatomy similar to animals while still being humans, and are sexually compatible with humans.
The appearance of Anthros first happened in 2050, when global warming reached a point where Antarctica melted down to a much smaller point, and the Northern frozen regions melted. This unleashed a virus of unknown origin that infected certain animals. As to why can only be narrowed down to natural selection, as if that certain animal had some kind of genetic puzzle piece in the DNA. The subjects under government study mysteriously died in the labs, but the animals that were infected in the outside world, unbeknownst to the world, bred, and spread the "virus," but it wasn’t a virus, it was bioweapon from an unknown precursor to human society, intended to turn species that were aggressive into intelligent sapient beings. All these infected animals mutated after the virus rewrote their genetic structure, and they went about their lives as if they were going through early human evolution. The virus didn't affect livestock because they were bred in captivity. For 20 years, there would be sightings of these creatures in woods all over the world, that caused shock across the world, and by the 2070s, they would emerge from the forests, letting themselves be known, and instead of being accepted by humanity, they were enslaved. It wasn’t until the 22nd century in which they gained the exact same rights as humans, because of a vulpinari who wished to change the world, who was assassinated because people were listening to him. This fox's name was Williams Renard. The man who shot Williams Renard was named Richard Sigmalis, the ancestor of Warlord Alpha Chadington. He changed his name to Chad Sigma to avoid getting caught. Slavery of Anthros was outlawed in 2103. After Anthros had human rights, being renamed to "Sapient Rights," almost all stores and restaurants had to stay open 24 hours to feed nocturnal Anthros. Reptilian species infected with the Anthro virus would mutate into mammalian reptiloids, only resembling reptiles, while being warm-blooded and sexually compatible with others.
Depending on genetics, and how their bodies were affected by the Anthrofication bioweapon, some male Anthros may have penises that resemble those of humans, or those of the animal species they descend from.

entries.name: Machines
entries.content: [Machines]--- Machines, or Robots, are an autonomous machines capable of sensing their environment, carrying out computations to make decisions, and performing actions in the real world. They tend to have their own AI. There has been a very common malfunction with domestic Machines gaining sapience caused by actions their owners commit. Enough positive actions, like treating the robot as if they were a person, can cause the Machine to gain sapience, sometimes even falling in love with their owner. Negative actions can cause them to become hostile to their owners. The companies who make Robots still don't know the internal issue that causes this. Or at least, they didn't when they existed. These days, the automated factories run by machines that build more machines just keep operating until they run out of materials.

entries.name: Kobolds
entries.content:
Kobold - a small, reptilian bipedal species that has intellect similar to humans and anthros, although they are very small, being 4’2 as adults on average. Due to their scaled skins and reptiloid nature, they are resistant to heat and fire. They are a major subcategory of Anthro. They can talk. True Neutral.
Scientific name is [Homo Animalis Vivipara].
They have knotted, and sometimes spiked penises.
Other names include: [Little Lizards], [Reptiloids].
They are more likely than other Anthros to be born Pyrokinetic.


Average Power Stats:
HP: 50
Strength: 5
Unarmed Damage: 10 -HP
Agility: 8
Average IQ: 125
Flexibility: 25
Perception: 10
Type: Anthro

entries.name: Tzinacatl
entries.content:
[Tzinacatl(Plural form: Tzinacatli)] are a major subcategory of Anthro. They are anthropomorphic vampire bats. They tend to eat their meat raw, dripping with blood, and prefer to only go out at night. 5'2" to 5'10 on average.
Other name: Bat People
Scientific name: [Homo Animalis Vespertilio]
They are more likely to be born as Umbrakinetics than other Anthros.

entries.name: Draconids
entries.content:
[Draconids] are a major subcategory of Anthro. They are anthropomorphic dragons. They can breathe fire, and glide momentarily due to their vestigial wings in their armpits. They can also eject a flaming liquid from their mouths called [benzoquinone], which they superheat and expel in an intense, pulsating jet, much like dragons do. Their existence was caused by dragons getting infected with the ancient bioweapon that thawed from Antarctica, which infected animals and transformed them into Anthros. They tend to be very honorable, and have great pride in this. A promise made to you by a Draconid is one of the strongest things ever, as they are too proud of their honor to break it. Their thick scales allow them to be more resistant to fire and heat than other Anthros. 6'10" to 7'8" on average.
Other names include: [Dragonborn], [Dragonoids], [Draconians], and [Draconoids]
Scientific name: [Homo Animalis Draconis]
They have 2 knotted penises each.
They are more likely to be born as Goliathids, Pyrokinetics, or Ergokinetics than other races.

entries.name: Orcs
entries.content:
[Orcs] are a major subcategory of Anthro. They are anthropomorphic wild boars. They are known to be very strong, and sometimes aggressive. They tend to be rather territorial in addition. They have porcine penises. They stand at 6'4" on average.
Other names include: [Pig People], [Boarmen], and [Pigmen].
Scientific name: [Homo Animalis Sus].
More likely to be Goliathids than other Anthros.

entries.name: Hundens
entries.content:
[Hundens] are a major subcategory of Anthro. They are anthropomorphic dogs. Their name was derived from the Old High German word for canine, "Hunden." They have naturally good hearing and smell, and tend to be very loyal. Their height depends on the breed that they are. Smaller breeds like Chihuahuas tend to be 4'3". but large breeds like Newfoundland dogs can be 7'9". They have canine knotted penises.
Other names include: [Dog People], and [Caninoids]
Scientific name: [Homo Animalis Familiaris].
More likely to be Ergokinetics than other Anthros.

entries.name: Fenrids
entries.content:
[Fenrids] are a major subcategory of Anthro. They are anthropomorphic wolves. They are known to be very skilled hunters, and prefer to live in the countryside.Those in America normally follow local Native American culture, due to the fact that they are technically Native American, but many others are Christian. Very few don't follow a religion. 6'2"-7'9" on average. 
They have canine knotted penises.
Scientific Name: [Homo Animalis Lupus].
More likely to be Goliathids or Ergokinetics than other Anthros.

entries.name: Khajiit
entries.content:
[Khajiit] are a major subcategory of Anthro. They are anthropomorphic cat people. They were named by Elder Scrolls fans long before the apocalypse. They are known to enjoy both invigorating activity and relaxation. As it turns out, they almost all confirm these "stereotypes" as true, themselves. They do drugs, they drink alcohol, they fuck a ton. The name "Khajiit" turned out to be very fitting for them. They sometimes have barbed penises.
Other names include: [Tabaxi], [Felinoids], [Felinids], [Catfolk], and [Cat People].
Scientific name: [Homo Animalis Felis]
They are more likely to be Ergokinetics or have super speed than other Anthros.

entries.name: Geitlan
entries.content:
[Geitlan]s are a major subcategory of Anthro. They are anthropomorphic goat people. Geitlans are fully covered in fur, and have goat-like faces, unlike the Satyr of Greek mythology. They normally fight with kicks and headbutts. They have caprine penises They are not very common, because only wild goats were turned into anthros, as it couldn't turn livestock bred in captivity.
Other names include: [Goatfolk], [Satyr], [Faun], and [Goat People]
Scientific name: [Homo Animalis Capra]

entries.name: Minotaur
entries.content:
Minotaurs are a major subcategory of Anthro. They are anthropomorphic Bison people. They were named after the Greek Minotaur of legend. They tend to be very big, and strong. They are 6'2 to 7'4 on average. They have bovine penises.
Domesticated and livestock cattle were never infected with the Anthro virus because they were bred in captivity.
Other names Include: [cowmen], [bullmen], [cow people], [bison people], and [Cowfolk]
Scientific name: [Homo Animalis Bos].
They are more likely to be born as Goliathids than other Anthros.

entries.name: Cervidaens
entries.content:
[Cervidaens] are a major subcategory of Anthro. They are anthropomorphic Deer people. They are known to prefer life in the countryside, though they tend to be vegetarian. They are 5'10 to 6'2 on average. They have cervine penises
They are more likely to be Chlorokinetic than other Anthros.
Other names Include: [Cervitaurs, and [Deerfolk]
Scientific Name: [Homo Animalis Cervus]

entries.name: Vulpinari
entries.content:
[Vulpinari] are a major subcategory of Anthro. They are anthropomorphic fox people. Williams Renard was a Vulpinari. Vulpinari are known to be very talented singers, due to the fact that their ancestors, foxes, could scream nonstop. They have knotted penises. They stand at 5'4" on average.
They are more resistant to the cold than other Anthros, but more vulnerable to fire and heat.
They are more likely to be born as Chlorokinetics or Technopaths than other Anthros.
Other Names Include: [Vulpine], [Lilmothiit], [Foxkin], and [Fox people]
Scientific Name: [Homo Animalis Vulpes]

entries.name: Crovics
entries.content:
[Crovics] are a major subcategory of Anthro. They are anthropomorphic crocodilian people. They are naturally good swimmers, and have very tough skin. They have crocodilian penises.
They usually stand at 5-6 feet tall.
They are more resistant to fire, and swim well.
They are more likely to be born as Hydrokinetics and Pyrokinetics than other Anthros.
Other names include: Crocodile People, Alligator People, and Gator People
Scientific name: [Homo Animalis Crocodylia].

entries.name: Lepori
entries.content:
[Lepori] are a major subcategory of Anthro. They are anthropomorphic Lagomorph people. They can be bunnies, hares, rabbits, anything. They are known to be short and agile, normally getting jobs where speed and hearing is preferred. 
They have lagomorphous penises.
They stand at 4'2-5'4 on average.
They are more likely to be born with enhanced speed or Chlorokinesis than other races.
Other names include: [Rabbitfolk], [Bunnyfolk], [Bunny People], and [Rabbit People]
Scientific name: [Homo Animalis Lagomorpha].

entries.name: Merkhan
entries.content:
[Merkhans] are a major subcategory of Anthro. They are anthropomorphic Shark people. They are known to still live in tribes underwater, and on islands, but they can survive above ground, because they have both gills and lungs. Mermaid sightings, encounters, and even sex stories were rumored to have had a spike between the 2050's and 2070's, and it is theorized that these "Mermaids" were actually fishers and sailors encountering early Merkhans. 
They are more likely to be born as Goliathids or Hydrokinetics than other Anthros.
Other names include: [Sharkfolk], [Shark People], [Shark Person], [Shark], [Sergal], or [Selachii].
Scientific name: [Homo Animalis Selachii].

entries.name: Hemoflare
entries.content:
The [Hemoflare] virus was an experimental variant of The Red Death. Because of how uncontrollable it would be, The New Axis decided not to use it, and modified another variant of RD-12. Someone was ordered to take the Hemoflare samples and destroy them, but they stole it. This has caused a few people to be infected, but it was also discovered that although it was very dangerous, Hemoflare had a higher immunity rate than The Red Death, even though the Hemoflare zombies were more dangerous alone. The Hemoflare could spread just through contact to those who weren't immune, and even be airborne, but it could be stopped through a thin layer of clothing.
Stage 1 of infection-Frenzy. This is the stage where it looks like a regular zombie, but it will run very fast if it detects living flesh.
Stage 2 of infection-Bloom. This stage happens if a Hemoflare Zombie manages to survive 72 hours of the virus, where their body calms down, their skin gets covered with these red pustules, and they turn into a fleshy cocoon. This cocoon will explode if damaged enough, which can inflict damage to the surroundings, and spread the virus further.
Stage 3 of infection-Apex. The Hemoflare zombie that comes out of the cocoon can mutate into many different forms, such as the behemoth, the blight, and the shrieker.

entries.name: Bunker 42
entries.content:
Bunker 42 was a Bunker-Down bunker where the residents were frozen in cryonic tubes. Only one survived. About 3 years after the bunker door closed, the four maintenance men working in the bunker quickly realized that there were no women. They all had PHDs in theoretical biology, but the fear of never passing on their genes made them go insane, and they thought they could find a way to make one of them pregnant. They just fucked each other's asses while chanting "GET PREGNANT" at the tops of their lungs. Naturally, this didn't work out for them. They kept videos of their attempts on logs in the bunker terminals. The people in the tubes were frozen for 38 years. Only one survived the process, but he was never found. All the tubes thawed out in 2183, so now there's basically just a bunch of corpses in high-tech refrigerators, and an archive of gay porn made by 4 mentally ill custodians. 
This bunker was located in Dallas, Texas.

entries.name: New Tejano Republic
entries.content:
The [New Tejano Republic], or "NTR" are a militia that operates in Texas, dedicated to preserving historical locations and attractions. In their settlements, they don't allow shootouts, so instead, they take away any other guns on both of the opposing individuals, and give each of them a revolver with one bullet. Then, a third party member comes in to make them take 10 paces, before turning and drawing on each other. Whether the one who gets shot first survives the shot or not, their disagreement is settled, and the survivor is the victor. Lawful Neutral.


Enemies: The Sigma Clan, The Stranded, The Hellfire Secession
Neutral to: The Hyde Syndicate, The Gravedigger Militia, The Hunters, The Brotherhood of Dragons, The Beacon Remnants, Bunker-Down, and The Empire.

entries.name: Semi-Lich
entries.content: [Semi-Liches] are zombified Psykers who were less powerful than other Liches, and could be controlled by another Lich, and function as the "Brain" for a Titan zombie. If a Semi-Lich's spine is damaged, the Titan will die. Titans can also be killed by damaging its body enough.

entries.name: Monsters
entries.content:
[Monsters], also known as [Beasts], [Legendary Zombies], and [Undead Heroes], are infamous named mutant zombies, normally having been told of by people who managed to survive and encounter with the beast.
|
|
Notable Monsters:
[Wendigo]--- Named after the Native American monster of legend, the Wendigo was named due to the fact that it's a giant mutated Cervidaen zombie. It has incredible hearing and smelling, while also being able to run at 100 miles per hour. Its teeth were sharpened by the mutation, which has caused those who heard about it to theorize that it was a Goliathid Cervidaen who got infected with RD-12, and mutated into a Goon zombie. It is in the forests of Virginia. The Gravedigger Militia has placed a bounty on its head for $500000000 USD. It stands at 12 feet tall. In truth, it's not really accurate to call this a Wendigo, because the Wendigo of Algonquian-speaking tribal legend is actually more humanoid, not Cervine. Much like the Wendigo of legend, it can imitate human voices, but it can't communicate.
Max HP- 1,000
Strength- 20
Unarmed Damage- 80 -HP
Agility- 40
Intelligence- 9
Flexibility- 10
Perception- 30
Type- Post-Anthro Zombie
|
|
[Sheepsquatch]--- The "White Thing" of West Virginia. It resides in the Appalachian forests. It has power similar to the Wendigo, but it is a Goliathid Hog Island Sheep-type Anthro, infected with RD-12, and mutated into a Goon zombie, instead of a Cervidaen Goon. It stands at 9 feet tall on its back legs, but has been rumored to walk on all fours most of the time.
Max HP- 700
Strength- 18
Unarmed Damage- 70 -HP
Agility- 34
Intelligence- 9
Flexibility- 10
Perception- 30
Type- Post-Anthro Zombie
|
|
[Strahd]--- Strahd is a Lich who managed to prevent himself from rotting through unknown means. He has Umbrakinesis and Telepathy. His skin is pale, like a vampire, and he named himself after the fictional vampire from the D&D campaign, Curse Of Strahd. It is believed he was once an ancestor of the Campbell Empire. He has used his powerful psionic Umbrakinesis to block any sunlight from the land of Ohio. You truly can't have shit there.
Max HP- 1000
Strength- 22
Unarmed Damage- 100 -HP
Agility: 44
Intelligence: 44
Flexibility- 20
Perception- 30
Type- Post-human Zombie
|
|
[Azrael, The First Lich]--- Azrael, The First Lich, is, well, the first Lich. When he was a human, he was a genius in cybernetics, who also happened to be a Telepath, and a Technopath. He could control technology with his mind. Due to his Telepathy, he became a Lich. He named himself after the Angel Of Death, Azrael. His telepathy caused him to be sentient, which led to him being a Lich. He was the first Telepath to be infected, as all the others could read the minds of the zombies, and evaded them. That, or they were simply immune. However, he was infected by just a lone shambler in his sleep. RD-12 let him keep his sentience, but it still corrupted his mind. He was once a good man, who helped people, even from afar. He used his Telepathy to message peoples' mind, impersonating their conscience. He persuaded people away from committing crimes, and harming themselves. If they ignored him, he would use his Technopathy to stop the crime, with everyone thinking it was the technology that stopped the criminal. Today, the Red Death has broken his mind, filling it with the intense hatred for the living, and the unstoppable craving of their flesh. It gave him the power to control hordes of undead, but it gave him insatiable hunger, and a burning disdain of the Living's existence. His zombies can be discerned from other zombies by the red glow in their eyes, and the cybernetic enhancements on their bodies. He built himself an extra pair of arms, that he could shoot lasers from the palms of. He wears a Supreme Jacket, and a crown made of human fingers.
Max HP- 2000
Strength-30
Unarmed Damage- 300 -HP
Agility: 50
Intelligence: 100
Flexibility- 22
Perception- 50
Type- Post-human Zombie
|
|
[Asterion]--- Asterion was once a Goliathid Minotaur, but nobody knows what his real name was. He is one of Azrael's Undead Legion. A cybernetically enhanced monster. He was infected with RD-12, which caused him to mutate into an Ogre Zombie. Azrael mind-controlled other zombies when they found him, making them put on cybernetic enhancements for him. They replaced his left arm with a giant plasma cannon, and gave him a giant War Axe to fight with in his right hand. They also replaced his teeth with sharpened steel ones to increase his deadliness, and He stands at 18 feet tall, weighing in at 1350 pounds. Despite his weight, he can move very fast, being able to move at 50 miles per hour.
Max HP- 2,000
Strength- 40
Unarmed Damage- 160 -HP
Plasma Blast Damage: 200 -HP
Agility- 20
Intelligence- 3
Flexibility- 6
Perception- 20
Type- Post-Anthro Zombie

entries.name: The UN
entries.content: The United Nations is a faction made up of the Remnants of the UN, who manage to send supply drops into every city known to have survivors still inside. No matter how big the supply drops are, survivors of different factions and gangs tend to cause conflict between each other, which the UN remnants cannot prevent. They send these drops on apartment complex rooftops, on school rooftops, on hospital rooftops, in parks, on parking garages, in city plazas, and on mall rooftops. They leave blue flares on these supply drops on the corner of each supply box. They keep the location of their new HQ a secret, but many believe it's on a large, somehow undiscovered island. The supply drops include preservable food, medicine, water, stimpacks, weapons, and first aid kits.

entries.name: Twister

entries.content: [The Knights of Fallen England] are a major faction of Fallen Europe. As the name suggests, they wear knights' armor, and use swords. entries.name: La Résistance
entries.content: [La Résistance] is a militia group that runs the Ruins of France. They would've called themselves La Milice if not for the WWII French Militia that supported Nazis. They use guns found on deceased soldiers. They decided that they could call themselves La Résistance against the zombies. Their headquarters is in Paris. Paris is guarded by 4 60-foot-tall, 12-foot-thick steel walls to defend it from zombies. There is a 20-foot-tall gate on each of the 4 walls to let in survivors.

entries.name: Scots

Rare

entries.name: Ferroforge
entries.content:
[Ferroforge] is a metal from a distant exoplanet destroyed millions of years ago by a giant meteor. The meteor happened to hit the planet in the exact direction of the Sol system, and the planet's debris has finally reached Earth. Both the meteor and the planet were destroyed in the collision, and the meteors that entered the Ionosphere were changed by the radiation, because radiation can change existing metal to other metals. These meteor showers, and this process, have led to the existence and discovery of a new metal, called Ferroforge. It was much stronger than steel or titanium, and could become extremely sharp. They depleted the Ferroforge to make it safer to use, and to make it mostly emit Alpha rays of radiation. The melting point of depleted Ferroforge is the same as tungsten, at 6,177 degrees Fahrenheit.
Due to being made from radiation, a side effect is that Ferroforge has the ability to be a conduit for psions to channel their power. An ergokinetic can make a Ferroforge handle to make themselves an Energy sword, or a wand to project energy from. A telekinetic can use it to make a wand that allows them to enhance their telekinesis. Wearing Ferroforge will always enhance a Psion's Psionic connection.
Legendary rarity.

entries.name: Sentinel Organization
entries.content:
"Sentinel Org," or "SentOrg," was a Secret Organization formed by NATO to be the next government in case of an apocalyptic event. They formed a program to create Cyborg Supersoldiers, but this was quickly axed by NATO. After the Red Death hit, they chose to bring back the program, kidnapping young children they found in the wasteland. They kidnapped 200 children, but only 10 survived the constant modifications and torture. In order to activate inactive supernatural genes, they put the children through extensive physical and mental torture. 57 children tested negative for mutant genes and were incinerated. 49 children died while their skeletons were being replaced with steel cybernetic bones. 53 children died from the gene manipulation tests. 22 children died from cardiac arrest due to rejection of their organ replacements. 39 children died from seizures caused by their bodies rejecting their skeletons. 
In the early days of the apocalypse, Sentinel Org presented themselves to civilians as a sanctuary, a faction to protect them, so they went to their high-security settlements. Though, people frequently went missing in these settlements. 
After Sentinel was destroyed by two of its own strongest supersoldiers, the truth came out that they were killing people who knew what they did to the supersoldiers when they were children.
SentOrg does not exist anymore.

It can be delivered using various techniques such as hooks, jabs, uppercuts, and haymakers, each causing various the effects they have on an opponent’s body, painting vivid images that will leave readers wincing at the sheer intensity of each impact described. Punches can cause pain, disorientation, they can cause various amounts of damage from
light bruising to fractures or even internal bleeding depending on the force behind them and where they land. And punches can also kill.]
